header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.text: place his trust only in his own worship, nor impose rulings harshly upon those who run into sin and regard them with contempt; this is the meaning of the above hadith.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يُبْصِرُ اَحَدُكُمْ الْقَذَاةَ فِيْ عَيْنِ اَخِيْهِ وَيَنْسَي الْجِذْعَ فِيْ عَيْنِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “A man sees even a small speck in his brother's eye, but forgets even the big tree in his own eye.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of this hadith is: “Even the most ordinary fault of others is seen, while one's own great faults are not seen by oneself.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ رَافِعٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ غَسَلَ مَيِّتًا فَكَتَمَ عَلَيْهِ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ اَرْبَعِيْنَ كَبِيْرَةً، وَمَنْ حَفَرَ لِأَخِيْهِ قَبْرًا حَتَّي يُجِنَّهُ فَكَاَنَّمَا اَسْكَنَهُ مَسْكَنًا حَتَّي يُبْعَثَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد: ٣ /١١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Rafi' (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever, while washing a dead person, conceals the faults of the dead person (his private parts and whatever is on his body), Allah Ta'ala will forgive forty of his major sins. Whoever digs a grave (Qabr) for his (deceased) brother and buries the dead person in it, is like one who has given him a place to stay until he is raised again (on the Day of Qiyamah)” (he will receive the reward of giving that person a place to stay until the Day of Qiyamah).
